selection: Manually reviewed zsh, direct Claude JSONL and literal Codex orchestration candidates. Current experiment source-inspection commands are excluded from the Codex selection. Orchestration literals do not prove actual dispatch. No raw commands or private payloads are stored in this labels file. Execution is modeled under declared command-scoped fixture assumptions, not reconstructed historical outcomes.
